evidence.note: 7 tests: the domain-purity and provider-boundary lint rules are asserted through the real ESLint config, so the constraint fails the build rather than living in prose

GAP-000.notes: Monorepo, quality gate, AGENTS.md, PRODUCT/ARCHITECTURE/SECURITY/OPERATIONS, ADRs 0001-0003, backlog schema, CI with a separate Postgres migration job.

evidence.note: 18 tests. Full transition matrix asserted against the declared table; every status proven reachable from draft; filled unreachable from any status except mastery_check and review_due; mastery_confirmed refused when a required objective is unmastered or when there are no required objectives at all

GAP-001.notes: Acceptance 'consumption cannot directly set filled' is covered by the test that iterates every status and asserts the mastery_confirmed transition is refused.

evidence.note: 18 tests. Terminal statuses reject all transitions; partial is reachable only from repairing, synthesising_audio and publishing; decideStep reuses recorded output rather than recomputing, re-runs an expired lease, and abandons after 3 attempts carrying the last error

GAP-002.notes: Step identity is (run, step, subject, inputVersion). The subject field separates concurrent instances of the same step, which is what makes per-day lesson generation safe to retry independently.

evidence.note: 22 tests. Wrong schemaVersion rejected; unknown fields rejected rather than dropped; multiple-choice answer must be among distinct options; free response must ship a rubric; a source-grounded item must cite a locator; the evidence fence cannot be forged by a document

17 tests. A structurally invalid response is rejected at the boundary and never returned; the failing field names are reported so a repair can be targeted; a rejected response is still charged for; source text never enters the instruction or the log; the budget check happens before the provider is reached (backend.calls is empty)
13 tests. Budgets refuse pre-call at both run and per-user-daily scope; spend does not cross users or days; cost is integer millicents so 300 sub-cent calls do not drift

GAP-003.notes: GAPOS_PROVIDER_MODE defaults to fake, and mode=live throws pointing at the human approval gate rather than silently falling back — a staging run cannot quietly be a fake run.
